[[File:Lakeshire Town Hall.jpg|thumb|300px|Lakeshire Town Hall]]
The '''Lakeshire Town Hall''' in the [[Redridge Mountains]] is an old building that has been diligently refurbished several times. The [[town hall]] is commonly the seat of rule by the local magistrate, and the current magistrate, [[Magistrate Solomon|Solomon]], is a kind and wise ruler. The town's problems with [[gnoll]]s and [[Blackrock Clan|Blackrock]] orcs has put him in a state of desperation, however, and he readily accepts aid from helpful adventurers.
